youtubeAnalytics.title: YouTube Channel Analytics
youtubeAnalytics.subtitle: Connect your Google channel to read private performance data directly from YouTube Analytics. This permission is separate from AIVISO sign-in.
youtubeAnalytics.connectDescription: AIVISO requests read-only permissions. Tokens are encrypted at rest and you can revoke access from this page at any time.
youtubeAnalytics.scopeChannel: View YouTube channels you own or manage
youtubeAnalytics.scopeAnalytics: Read views, watch time, average view duration, and subscriber changes
youtubeAnalytics.scopeRevenue: Read estimated revenue and ad performance when your account is eligible
youtubeAnalytics.noRevenueAccess: Revenue reporting access has not been granted
youtubeAnalytics.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect YouTube and remove the stored tokens from AIVISO?
youtubeAnalytics.disconnectedNotice: YouTube was disconnected and local tokens were deleted.
youtubeAnalytics.connectFailed: YouTube connection failed. Check OAuth configuration and try again.
youtubeAnalytics.notConfigured: YouTube OAuth is not configured on the server.
youtubeAnalytics.channelConflict: One of the channels is already linked to another AIVISO account.
youtubeAnalytics.sessionExpired: Your AIVISO session expired during OAuth. Sign in again and reconnect.
youtubeAnalytics.noChannels: The Google account is connected, but no readable YouTube channel was found. Make sure this account owns or manages a YouTube channel.
youtubeAnalytics.noRows: No Analytics data is available for this date range yet.

studio.savedNoteA: Every result is saved automatically in
studio.savedNoteB: and can be reopened any time.

videoStudio.subtitle: One topic becomes a complete video: an AI storyboard, a 10-second visual per scene, voice narration, then everything is assembled by 5 parallel agents. Shorts are capped at 90 seconds, long videos at 10:45.
videoStudio.topicPlaceholder: e.g. 5 morning habits that changed my life as a student
videoStudio.researchDesc: Finds real references on YouTube, Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and Yandex - keeps the script grounded.
videoStudio.renderFast: Fast - AI images with motion (done in minutes)
videoStudio.renderHelpCinematic: Each scene renders as a 10-second AI video clip. Gateway clip quota is limited - scenes that hit the cap fall back to animated AI images and the video still completes.
videoStudio.renderHelpFast: Every scene is an AI image with camera motion + narration. Estimate: a 90-second Short finishes in ±2-3 minutes.
videoStudio.runningNote: Render is running. You can close this page and come back via history.
videoStudio.emptyDesc: Write a topic on the left, pick a format (Short 90s or long video up to 10:45), then 5 agents will build the storyboard, generate a visual per 10 seconds, add narration, and assemble it all into one video.
videoStudio.sceneStats: {videoClips} AI-clip scene(s), {imageClips} animated image scene(s){fallback} - duration {duration} - {size}
videoStudio.toastErrorDesc: Something went wrong while processing the video.
videoStudio.topicTooShortDesc: Write a video topic of at least 5 characters.
videoStudio.networkErrorDesc: Check your connection and try again.
